core_obligations: The author structural decomposition of a stable Hamiltonian flow reduces orbit scarcity to surface return dynamics and torus-bundle monodromy. dedup.scope: Same-source public2315 is a local helix-box Birkhoff section construction for torus-invariant flows. Original contact-nondegenerate condition applies only to the stated nonzero-orbit theorem; zero and finite regimes form one combined classification object. Global generic Birkhoff-section results remain context, not counted here.
